J0: FIRST_HALF_KICK from authenticated frozen start snapshot
J1: SECOND_HALF_KICK from NEW authenticated post-drift snapshot; previous_occurrence required, distinct record even if bits equal
acquisition_record: canonical exact full snapshot with phase, record/acquisition ids, executor/tool hashes and previous occurrence; externally collected bytes immutable; hash equality alone is not authentic acquisition
cache: V1 state-dependent mathematical and occurrence caches DISABLED; future mathematical cache needs all projection/spec/method/source/wire keys and full recheck; always new occurrence binding, never old execution identity
canonical_hash: artifact SHA256=SHA256(canonical bytes); identity SHA256=SHA256(ASCII domain label + NUL + canonical payload); no own hash embedded in hashed payload
comparison: external result carries full identity + full J_raw; missing acquisition or source binding => NOT_AVAILABLE/STOP; no external raw in producer input
full_state: atoms array exactly [i,j]; each atom atom_id (64 lowercase hex), species=Ar40, position_raw[3], momentum_raw[3]; all raw signed96; includes position/momentum grid and constants/spec reference
math_request: projection hash, method/version, proof wire version, axis convention; policy changes availability but not physical truth
occurrence: record_id/acquisition_id (64 hex), acquisition_record_sha256, full_state_sha256, projection_sha256, phase FIRST_HALF_KICK or SECOND_HALF_KICK, full_half=HALF_OF_FULL_DT, atom roles and xyz, executor_source_sha256 and acquisition_tool_sha256, previous_occurrence_sha256|null
projection: spec/constants/domain; atom identity and roles [i,j]; position raws and grid; species; full_dt=40/1; kick_fraction=1/2; excludes momentum and supplied external J
unresolved_items: acquisition tool implementation and authenticated execution capture are not present
